We need to propose retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1.

We need to output JSON tree with type mol, children reaction nodes etc. Need to find appropriate templates: likely steps: 1) amide formation between carboxylic acid and aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So precursor: acid (C=O) part: maybe trans-α,β-unsaturated acid attached to aromatic sulfonyl phenyl. The target has amide linking to aniline (anilide). So retrosynthesis: break amide to give acid (trans-α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). Reaction type: amide coupling (carboxylic acid + amine). So step 1: target -> acid + aniline.

Step 2: The unsaturated acid could be formed via Doebner modification from aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid, giving α,β-unsaturated acid attached to aromatic sulfonyl phenyl. So break C=C double bond formation and decarboxylation? Actually forward Doebner: aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid (with loss of CO2). So retrosynthesis: unsaturated acid -> aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid. So step 2: acid precursor is aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2 attached to sulfonyl) plus malonic acid.

Step 3: The sulfonamide linking: target has sulfonamide connecting an aniline (first phenyl with methyl) to sulfonyl group attached to second phenyl. So we can break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride and aniline (the methyl phenyl amine). So step 3: sulfonamide formation: sulfonyl chloride + aniline (p-toluidine). So precursor: sulfonyl chloride attached to second phenyl (c2ccc(... )cc2) with sulfonyl chloride group.

Thus overall route: 1) amide coupling, 2) Doebner modification, 3) sulfonamide formation.
